card.title: Half a Beat Late
card.instruction: Use the group’s reactions as your cue, joining each one a moment late and escalating your enthusiasm to stay included.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Room on your blanket? Oh, everyone's cheering! Come on, Tigers! Best team in the county!

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Ooh, poor keeper. That's my daughter limping off. Hold her water.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Oh, poor love! I'll carry her bag too. She can have my chair!

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's waving us back! Yes! That's my girl! She's staying in goal!

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Oh, yes! Tigers forever! Can I join you every Saturday? I'll buy a season ticket!

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 catches up to cheering and seeks blanket space, A3 amplifies concern into several offers after the injury cue, and A5 amplifies renewed cheering into season-ticket belonging.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's limping daughter and water task cause A3's care offers; B4's return-to-goal pride causes A5's renewed team enthusiasm and weekly inclusion bid.

relationship.evidence: B2 has a real injured-player concern and B4 responds to the daughter's own reassuring wave.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4's changed mood to overcommit to continuing attendance rather than merely repeating the cheer.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes shared spectator space and a team; B2 identifies the keeper as B's daughter.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's season-ticket escalation is earned by B4's restored celebration and A1's request to join the blanket.
